description: The depositor katiewolfe publishes a three-dimensional scan of Eastern Avenue Sewage Pumping Station in Baltimore, United States. The public description reports reconstruction in RealityCapture from 2,564 camera and drone images. Zenodo offers a GLB mesh with JPEG thumbnails under CC BY 4.0 and identifies its Objaverse and Sketchfab provenance. The May 2022 record documents a specific wastewater-infrastructure building, completed in 1912 according to the deposited historical account. The mesh could supply exterior geometry for a visual digital twin or inspection-simulation scene. It does not provide the operating pump curves, wastewater flows or structural material properties needed for engineering analyses. Survey timing, coordinate reference, scale and accuracy remain unknown from the metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly names this asset mesh. The file inventory was inspected without downloading the geometry.
